name: Christopher A. Coons

pages.title: Chris Coons | U.S. Senator for Delaware
pages.text:
More Like Delaware
## Opportunity
Chris believes that in order for our country to succeed, we need a strong floor and no ceiling, so every Delawarean has the opportunity to build a better future for them and their family.
## Security
Chris believes that every Delawarean should feel safe and secure in their community — from their neighborhood to retirement.
## Justice
Chris’ faith teaches him that without justice, nothing else is possible.

pages.title: Priorities | Chris Coons
pages.text:
## Stand With Chris
Delaware and our country face big challenges. Costs are too high. It’s getting even harder to access quality, affordable health care. Families are feeling the squeeze when they go to the grocery store, plan for their kids’ future, and look ahead to retirement.
Trump is making it worse. His so-called Big Beautiful Bill slashed access to Medicaid, jeopardizing the health care of thousands of Delawareans. His unlawful tariffs spiked the costs of everyday expenses, making life even harder for families trying to get by. Around the world, Trump is making us less safe by alienating our allies and pushing them closer to China’s sphere of influence.
## Opportunity
Chris believes that in order for our country to succeed, we need a strong floor and no ceiling, so every Delawarean has the opportunity to build a better future for them and their family.
## Affordable Housing :
Chris knows that many Delawareans are struggling to afford their rent or buy a home, a critical step in getting ahead. Chris is committed to finding creative ways to eliminate roadblocks to home ownership, including pushing back on Trump’s unlawful tariffs that increase building costs and drive up the costs of new homes. In the Senate, Chris is leading the way to reform rental assistance, expand homeowner incentives, and streamline complicated federal programs. Chris has secured over $100 million in federal funds to invest in affordable housing initiatives across Delaware.
## Jobs :
Chris is a leader in the Senate for investments in education and workforce training programs that make sure Americans can compete in the global economy and win the 21st century. He is relentless in advocating for American manufacturing and innovation, two pillars that have long made the United States the envy of the world. Chris also has a long record of protecting the rights and pensions of organized labor.
## Health care:
Chris believes everyone should have access to quality, affordable health care, which is why he has fought against Trump’s threats to the Affordable Care Act and Medicaid. He has also worked to protect Delaware’s hospitals, reduce overcrowding in Emergency Departments, and increase access to innovative treatments.
## Security
Chris believes that every Delawarean should feel safe and secure in their community.
## Public Safety:
While in county government, Chris worked closely with the second largest police department in Delaware and understands the sacrifice officers make every day. As co-chair of the Senate Law Enforcement Caucus, he has worked to increase resources for local law enforcement, enforcing stricter gun violence prevention measures, and ensuring justice and rehabilitation systems serve communities effectively.
## Foreign Policy :
American foreign policy is fundamentally about ensuring our security and protecting our prosperity. That is why Chris has worked across the aisle to ensure we have the tools and strategy to compete with China and he remains committed to standing with Ukrainians in their fight for freedom. He is the senior Democrat for Defense Appropriations in the Senate, where he has delivered investments for our troops and ensured America stands ready to face the battles of tomorrow.
Delaware is our country’s lowest-lying state, and Chris knows that climate change represents a generational threat to our state, our country, and the entire planet. Throughout his time in the Senate, Chris has been a tireless advocate for climate solutions, and he’s been a key voice in supporting new clean energy technologies to reduce and eventually replace our reliance on fossil fuels.
## Justice
Chris’ faith teaches him that without justice, nothing else is possible.
## Integrity :
Too many Americans believe their government doesn’t work for them, which is why Chris is committed to leading with integrity and rebuilding a sense of fairness in our system, from holding his colleagues accountable as the Vice Chair of the Senate Ethics Committee to legislating on judicial ethics reforms.
## Constitutional rights:
As a senior member of the Senate Judiciary Committee, Chris is committed to pushing back on the Trump Administration’s attempts to weaponize the Department of Justice, install extreme and unqualified judges, and create a system that works for the few at the expense of the many. Chris is also a fierce defender of our constitutional rights, including protecting access to reproductive health care.
## Immigration :
Chris believes we need to focus on restoring fairness and justice to the American immigration system. That means enforcing the laws on the books and ensuring that the system isn’t run by unqualified, unaccountable federal immigration agents. He has worked throughout his career to find a path to comprehensive immigration reform and has worked to hold immigration officials to the same standards as local law enforcement. He has introduced legislation to create an oversight body to monitor abuses by Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and prevent those officers from entering vulnerable locations, such as schools and hospitals.

pages.title: Civil rights | Chris Coons
pages.text:
## Civil rights
Our nation is at a moment of reckoning. George Floyd, Ahmaud Arbery, Eric Garner, Freddie Gray, Breonna Taylor, and dozens of other Black American men, women, and children have lost their lives in acts of brutality. They were murdered, often by the very folks sworn to serve and protect all of us. It’s clear that institutions that are supposed to provide justice for every American have failed. We must do more than repair them — we must remake them more just than ever before.
Protecting the civil rights of every American is one of Chris’ top priorities, and he has been a leading voice on the Senate Judiciary Committee to ensure that every American is free from discrimination and able to exercise their constitutionally guaranteed rights. Chris is leading efforts to protect the right to vote for all Americans and to ensure that exercising your right to vote is safe. Chris is an original co-sponsor of the Justice in Policing Act which would finally designate lynching a federal hate crime and make it easier for the federal government to prosecute police misconduct.
Chris also works hard to protect our federal courts. He earned a reputation as a tough, detailed questioner when pressing President Trump’s judicial nominees about their positions on key issues like race discrimination, reproductive rights, and LGBTQ equality. He was crucial in blocking some of President Trump’s least qualified and most dangerous nominees from lifetime appointments to the federal bench.
Chris has led efforts to:
- Pass the Equality Act and ensure that LGBTQ Americans are free from discrimination.
- Guarantee the voting rights of every American through the Voting Rights Restoration Act and the FAST Voting Act.
- Fight discriminatory policies from the Trump Administration against people based on their gender, religion, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

pages.title: Addressing the climate crisis | Chris Coons
pages.text:
Chris believes that climate change represents an existential threat to Delaware (America’s lowest-lying state), our country, and the entire planet – and that we have to act boldly and quickly to address it.
That’s why Chris is a leading voice in the effort to pass legislation to put a price on carbon emissions, one of the most effective and practical solutions we have available to address the dangerous warming of our planet.
Throughout his time in the Senate, Chris has been a tireless advocate for climate solutions, and he’s been a key voice in supporting new clean energy technologies to reduce and eventually replace our reliance on fossil fuels.
Chris made national headlines by becoming the first Democratic senator to convince Republicans to take climate change seriously and join the bipartisan Climate Solutions Caucus.

pages.title: Criminal justice reform | Chris Coons
pages.text:
## Criminal justice reform
Chris was a key supporter of the First Step Act, the landmark criminal justice reform bill that was passed into law in late 2018, after years of hard work and negotiations.
He hasn’t stopped there, though. Chris is still working to reform our criminal justice system by making the sentencing system more just and more fair, encouraging the use of community policing, and treating drug addiction like the public health crisis it is.
Chris has also led efforts to reduce violence and crime in Delaware communities – from his work with the Obama administration to include Wilmington in the Violence Reduction Network to his efforts to reauthorize the Victims of Child Abuse Act.

pages.title: Gun violence | Chris Coons
pages.text:
## Gun violence
Chris believes that every American deserves the right to live without fear of gun violence in their communities. That’s why he is one of the strongest, most influential voices in the Senate for gun safety legislation.
Chris has shown time and again that he’s not afraid to stand up to the NRA, and he has been a champion for universal background checks, bills to keep guns out of the hands of stalkers and domestic abusers, and legislation to keep weapons of war out of our communities.
Chris has also led meaningful efforts to pass commonsense gun safety reforms in the face of inaction from Senate Republicans. He’s the author of a bipartisan bill to ensure that local law enforcement authorities are notified when someone who’s prohibited from buying a gun tries to purchase one anyway, and he’s been able to move that bill forward with bipartisan support.

pages.title: Health care | Chris Coons
pages.text:
## Health care
Chris believes that access to quality, affordable health care is a right, not a privilege, and he’s fighting harder than ever to make this a reality for all of us.
Chris helped to introduce and pass multiple significant relief packages during COVID-19 to benefit all Americans. These bills have included:
- Billions of dollars to increase our domestic testing capacity;
- Funding for resources — such as a Personal Protective Equipment — to benefit our health care heroes who are on the frontlines of this crisis;
- Grants to support doctors offices and hospitals and expand telehealth services during the COVID-19 pandemic;
- Plan to coordinate with AmeriCorps to implement a contact tracing program.
Chris has been a leader in the Senate to protect and expand the Affordable Care Act.
From bogus lawsuits and executive actions to dangerous bills that would cause Americans with pre-existing conditions to lose their coverage, Chris pushed back time and again on Republicans who wanted to put Americans’ health care back in the hands of insurance companies.
Chris has supported legislation to reduce the out-of-control costs of prescription drugs and hold pharmaceutical companies accountable.
In the Senate, Chris has also:
- Protected women’s access to health care by fighting to protect Planned Parenthood and blocking right-wing efforts to deny women the care they deserve.
- Voted to pass $3.7 billion in federal funding to help Delaware and other states take on the opioid crisis.
- Led an all-hands-on-deck approach to stop Delaware’s opioid abuse epidemic by bringing together federal, state, and local officials; law enforcement; community leaders; and more.
- Fought tooth and nail against Republican attempts to gut Medicare and Medicaid.
